name: Research a question across many sources and get a cited report
description: Run it with a research question. An AI agent splits it into three to six sub-questions, searches the web with Tavily and the biomedical literature with PubMed, keeps the most credible and recent sources, and reads the strongest ones in full with Firecrawl. It writes a report with an executive summary, findings per sub-question, an evidence-quality note on each finding, contradictions stated plainly and a numbered source list, saves it as a Google Doc and emails you the link.
shortDescription: A cited, multi-source research report saved to Google Docs.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with the deep-research skill and Tavily, Firecrawl and PubMed tools
Two rounds: breadth first, then full-text reading of the strongest sources
Every claim cited, with study type and preprint or peer-reviewed status noted
Report saved as a Google Doc and the link emailed to you
prerequisites: The `deep-research` skill created under Settings → AI → Skills, from the SKILL.md in the blue canvas note
Google Docs and Google Mail (Gmail) connection
idealFor: Marketing, strategy and research teams that need a credible, sourced answer rather than a quick summary.
steps: Trigger: run the workflow manually with the research question and your email address.
Research the question: the AI Agent loads the deep-research skill, plans sub-questions, searches with Tavily and PubMed, reads sources with Firecrawl and writes the report.
Save the report as a Google Doc.
